translate_en|mods/HF_PointBlankMod/42/me: Point Blank
Point Blank - Bonus Damage Multiplier (ONLY USED WHEN InstantKill is DISABLED)

This multiplier is applied to your bonus damage from above. This does NOT affect BASE damage value, ONLY bonus damage. See equation below: 

 TotalDamage = BaseDamage + PointBlankDamage
 PointBlankDamage = (Max(BaseDamage,PointBlankMinimumBonusDamage) * PointBlankBonusDamageMultiplier )
Point Blank - Cooldown Between Point Blank Kills at Min Aiming Skill (seconds)

Real-world seconds required between point blank triggers at Aiming skill level 0, regardless of game speed or framerate. This is the longest the cooldown gets - it scales down toward PointBlankCooldownDurationMin as Aiming skill increases.
Point Blank - Cooldown Between Point Blank Kills at Max Aiming Skill (seconds)

The cooldown used once the player has reached Aiming skill level 10. This is the shortest the cooldown gets - it scales linearly between this and PointBlankCooldownDurationMax based on the player's current Aiming skill level.
Point Blank - Disable Multiplayer Command Updates

For debugging purposes. You shouldn't change this. But if you're having server/client/networking issues, this will disable synchronous server/client updates. Without this, when you pointblank kill a zed, there can be a delay for them to appear dead for other players.
Point Blank - Effective Range
Point Blank - Effective Range (Two-Handed Weapons)
Same as Point Blank Effective Range, but for two-handed weapons (rifles, shotguns). Set higher than the value above, since the muzzle sits further from the player's body.
Zombies shot at a distance below this value will take point blank damage. Applies to one-handed weapons (pistols, revolvers).
Point Blank - Experimental Hit Limitations

Limits one trigger pull to a single point blank victim. Point Blank resolves its kill before the engine picks what the bullet hits, so the engine skips the already-dead zombie and the shot can no longer put down a second one out of your line of fire. Turn this off to restore the previous behaviour.
Point Blank - Instant Kill

If TRUE, when shooting a zombie within point blank range, they die instantly. 
 If FALSE, the values below help determine bonus damage
Point Blank - Min Ticks Between Point Blank Kills
You can set this higher to enforce a "cooldown" between point blank kills. By default, this ensures point blank can't trigger multiple times in a single tick
Point Blank - Minimum Bonus Damage (ONLY USED WHEN InstantKill is DISABLED)

The minimum amount of bonus damage applied when InstantKill is disabled. 
For example, if your base damage is .0001, this raises the effective bonus damage to at least this value (default .15). 
 See equation below: 

 TotalDamage = BaseDamage + PointBlankDamage
 PointBlankDamage = (Max(BaseDamage,PointBlankMinimumBonusDamage) * PointBlankBonusDamageMultiplier )
Point Blank - Aiming Xp Multiplier
Any xp gains from killing a zombie will be multiplied by this value
